svg.title: Deal4Me: the rental, step by step
svg.desc: A state machine for one rental, with a red token moving through four states while a money ledger fills underneath. reserved, via POST /rentals/hold: a 6-digit pickup code and QR code. picked_up, via POST /rentals/[id]/pickup: 3 pickup photos. returned, via POST /rentals/[id]/return: 3 return photos and an AI damage check, where Claude Sonnet compares a pickup photo and a return photo of the skis and answers clear or review; a person makes the final call. settled, via POST /rentals/[id]/settle: the owner settles. Every transition is guarded and returns 409 if called out of order. The ledger shows a $370 hold, 3 days at $30 plus a $280 deposit, held, not charged; on settle $90 is captured and $280 released, because captured equals min(hold, fee plus damage). A badge notes this is a simulated payment ledger and no card is touched.

g.font-family: 'Public Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: One guarded API call per step; the money follows the gear.
Simulated payment ledger · no card is touched
A person makes the final call.
any charge ≤ deposit, with a note
